//: Typechecks e2e/** and playwright.config.ts, which tsconfig.json deliberately
Run it with: npm run typecheck:e2e
WHY IT IS SEPARATE. The app config sets types to [vitest/globals,
vite/client] on purpose: src/ is browser code, and adding 'node' there would
let a screen reach for `process.env` or `node:fs` and still typecheck, right
up until it failed on someone's phone. The e2e code is the opposite — it runs
in node, spawns psql, and reads process.env.CI — so it needs exactly the
types src/ must not have. Two configs is how each gets what it needs without
either getting what it must not have.
This is the same split tsconfig.functions.json already makes for the Edge
Functions, and for the same reason.
WHAT THIS CATCHES: a spec that drifts from the app — a fixture id renamed, a
helper whose signature changed, a Playwright API used wrongly. Without it the
only signal would be a failing run, which is slower and blames the wrong
WHAT IT DOES NOT CATCH: whether the selectors match anything. No type says a
heading reads 공지사항; only running the suite does.
